Wallpaper inspiration

Find your pattern.

Explore four looks, from bold feature walls to subtle finishes that work across an entire room.

Botanical

Leaf motifs and natural greens

Size & order

Oversized leaves suit a feature wall with simple furniture. For a quieter look, try smaller motifs in soft olive or sage.

Floral

Painterly blooms and soft colour

Size & order

Large, painterly blooms can frame a bed or sofa. Repeat one colour from the wallpaper in your cushions or curtains to tie the room together.

Textured

Woven looks and warm neutrals

Size & order

A fine weave adds depth to a wall in a neutral room. Look at a sample in daylight and under your evening lights, since both bring out different details.

Geometric

Repeating shapes and clean lines

Size & order

A repeating fan or diamond pattern gives an entryway or dining room a defined rhythm. Check how the repeat will sit around corners and doorways.
